profile.headline: Software Engineer, Machine Learning
profile.summary:
I am passionate about merging the worlds of philosophy and advanced machine learning. My journey in this field is driven by a deep fascination with the intricacies of reinforcement learning, large language models (LLMs), diffusion models, and all things related to generative AI.

My professional background is rooted in Responsible AI and Integrity, which provides me with a unique perspective on the ethical and societal implications of AI technologies. I am dedicated to advancing AI in a manner that is not only innovative but also ethical and responsible.

Whether it's delving into the theoretical underpinnings of AI or developing cutting-edge solutions, I am constantly seeking to push the boundaries of what is possible. My goal is to contribute to a future where AI enhances human potential while adhering to the highest standards of integrity.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
- Preprocessed emails from prospective tenants by removing spam emails, and performed feature selection.
- Implemented an ensemble classification model in Spacy that used a bag-of-words model and a CNN to classify emails based on natural language queries.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Executed SQL queries on tables containing human resource data to construct an undirected graph showing the movement of employees between companies.
- Generated embeddings for a subset of the graph using node2vec, and applied breadth-first search to calculate embeddings for companies not present in the subset.
- Wrote a Python script that interfaced with the Scala version of node2vec to take advantage of distributed computing.

projects.title: Real Estate Database Application
projects.description:
- Designed and developed a real estate database from scratch using PostgresSQL .
- Built a web front-end which interacted with the database using Flask and HTML.

projects.title: Tumor Detection using a Convolution Neural Network (CNN)
projects.description:
- Developed a data processing pipeline which carried out noise reduction, segmentation, and categorization of patches extracted from large image files.
- Used transfer learning to train a CNN using a small data set, and performed grid search to tune hyperparameters.
- Generated heat maps using LIME to visualize the parts of an image positively contributing to the model’s classification.
